data.name: Starfinding
data.description: A star watcher adds a %1 bonus on Knowledge (geography) checks. He can also use astrological methods to read people. By checking his star charts, he can use Knowledge (geography) in place of Sense Motive checks.|max(1,InvestigatorLVL/2)
